items.title: Google Deepmind's Genie 4 puts a modern spin on agent designs that predate LLMs
items.summary: Google Deepmind has introduced Genie 4, a real-time world model that simulates interactive 3D worlds with sound and talking characters. Gemini models help plan in the background to keep the simulation consistent. Genie 4 is still an early research model, and longer sessions lead to visual inconsistencies....

items.title: Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra tops Retell’s voice agent benchmark, while Codex helps it reach a $1.6M annual revenue run rate per employee.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-range model that cuts API prices in half compared to its predecessor. Analysts say it sets a new standard for intelligence per dollar, especially for everyday computing tasks and AI-driven computer control. The article GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Cloudflare’s Auto Router Rates Each Request for Stakes, from the Most Recent Turns
items.summary: Cloudflare has released Auto Router in public beta through AI Gateway, picking a model per request from a classifier that scores complexity, ambiguity, stakes and context dependence. Cloudflare’s own benchmark puts it ten points below Claude Opus 5.5 on success rate at a third of the cost, and practitioners have questioned how stakes survive a long agent session. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

items.title: Former Deepmind researcher thinks AlphaGo's playbook can cure AI hallucinations
items.summary: Former Deepmind researcher Thore Graepel wants his startup Metis Reasoning to bring AlphaGo's search principle to general reasoning. Instead of locking knowledge inside model weights, an explicit knowledge ledger would make every conclusion checkable against evidence. So far, though, there's no working system and no benchmarks....

items.title: OpenAI asks outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, to check proofs its AI produced in math, computer science, and physics
items.summary: OpenAI says its internal AI models have cracked three major open questions in math, computer science, and physics. One of them is part of a famous Millennium Prize Problem, each of which carries a $1 million prize. Outside experts, including a Nobel laureate, are now checking whether the proofs hold up. If the computer science proof holds on its own, hundreds of research papers lose their foundation....

items.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
items.summary: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown fourteenfold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

items.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
items.summary: OpenAI shares model results on the Kakeya conjecture, Exponential Time Hypothesis, and quantum chromodynamics—and how researchers can verify and build on them.

items.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
items.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.

items.title: How Check Point accelerates vulnerability research with Daybreak
items.summary: With OpenAI Daybreak, Check Point speeds up the research behind new security protections, enabling its analysts to turn vulnerability intelligence into customer defenses faster.

items.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
items.summary: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol to investigate security risks across complex codebases. Its security agent helps developers review findings and proposed fixes.
